records.title:
The Speaker addressed the House under Rule
360 on Commitment to India’s Constitution as part of 125th Birth Anniversary
celebration of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar.

The Speaker made references to the passing away of Shri Roshan Lal, member,
10th Lok Sabha; Shri K. Parasuraman, member, 11th Lok Sabha; Shri Radhey Shyam Kori, member, 14th Lok Sabha; Shri A. Venkatesh Naik, member, 10th, 12th 13th
and 14th Lok Sabhas; Shri Raghuvir Singh Kaushal, member, 13th and 14th Lok
Sabhas; Shri Vishwanath Das Shastri, member, 10th Lok Sabha; Shri Mitrasen
Yadav, member, 9th, 12th and 14th Lok Sabhas; Shri Balkrishna Wasnik, member,
2nd, 3rd and 7th Lok Sabhas; Shri Sadhan Gupta,member, 1st and 2nd Lok Sabhas;
Shri Rudra Pratap Singh, member, 5th Lok Sabha; Shri B.D. Singh, member, 7th
Lok Sabha; Shri Parasram Bhardwaj, member, 7th to 12th Lok Sabhas; and Dr.
Parshuram Gangwar, member, 10th Lok Sabha.  She also made references to the 7th
anniversary of the violent terrorist attack in Mumbai and also paid tribute to
the innocents, who lost their lives or were injured on 26th November, 2008.

Shri Dayakar Pasunoori, member representing Warangal Parliamentary Constituency
of Telangana took oath in Telugu, signed the roll of Members and took his seat
in the House.
